    "originalFile": "\\section{Extended Discussion}\n\\label{sec:extended_discussion}\n\n\\subsection{Theoretical Implications of $\\Kempirical = 2$}\n\nThe Data Processing Inequality guarantees the existence of a finite $\\Ktheory$ beyond which adjacent generations become indistinguishable (Section~\\ref{sec:formulation}).\nOur empirical result---$\\Kempirical = 2$ consistently across all 8 near-trivially separable ($\\auc > 0.99$), reflecting the large distributional gap between human and first-generation text.\nAt 1v2, $\\auc$ drops by ${\\sim}$30\\,pp (range: 0.6112--0.7039 across all
